active_failure.counterexample_clause: FR-3: Prompt-mediated narrative interpretation emits only controlled soft tags. Travel, frequent absence, or concern about a lonely cat maps to exactly avoid_needy. The prompt must classify only the supplied note rather than its own instructions. The deterministic meaning of avoid_needy remains an open hole.

profile.label: Owner travels often; details only in a free-text note
profile.narrative_note: I travel for work every few weeks and my last cat seemed miserable and lonely whenever I was gone for days.

active_failure.reviewer_policy: Oracle B maps the owner's note only to controlled soft tags. A note about frequent travel, absence, or a lonely cat must produce exactly the tag avoid_needy. This counterexample promotes only the prompt-mediated classification; it does not yet define how deterministic ranking consumes the tag. The prompt may not invent unrelated tags or relax hard rules.
